# TermFlow

> TermFlow is a private timetable, attendance and academic planning web app for IIM Sambalpur PGP2 students.

TermFlow helps eligible students view a personalized daily class timetable, track attendance, plan leave, follow exam and assignment deadlines, read schedule changes and campus announcements, and export calendar events. Access to personal student features requires an `@iimsambalpur.ac.in` Google account.

## Product identity

- Product name: TermFlow
- Also known as: PGP2 TermFlow, IIM Sambalpur PGP2 Schedule App, termflow pgp2
- Category: Educational web application and Progressive Web App (PWA)
- Audience: IIM Sambalpur PGP2 students (batch 2025–27)
- Programme covered: PGP2 (Post Graduate Programme, Year 2) at IIM Sambalpur
- Access: Institute Google account (@iimsambalpur.ac.in) required for personal features
- Cost: Free to eligible users
- Primary language and locale: English (India)

## Features

- **Personalized timetable** — Daily and weekly class schedule filtered by each student's elective choices and assigned section.
- **Attendance tracker** — Monitors attendance count and percentage per course, with the 75% minimum threshold highlighted.
- **Leave planner** — Calculates how many classes can be missed before falling below the attendance threshold.
- **Exam & assignment deadlines** — Centralized view of upcoming exams, quizzes and assignment submission dates.
- **Announcements** — Schedule changes, campus notices and administrative updates pushed to the app.
- **Mess menu** — Daily mess (cafeteria) menu integrated into the app.
- **Calendar export** — Export class events to Google Calendar or any iCal-compatible calendar app.
- **PWA / offline support** — Installable as a home-screen app on Android and iOS; cached schedule accessible offline.
- **Class reminders** — Push notifications for upcoming classes (opt-in).

## Access and eligibility

- A valid `@iimsambalpur.ac.in` Google account is required to sign in.
- The app is not available to PGP1 students, faculty, staff, or external users.
- Public pages (this file, about.html) contain product information only.

## What TermFlow does NOT do

- TermFlow does not expose any student's schedule, attendance record, course selections or personal information on its public pages.
- Time-sensitive timetable details are available only inside the authenticated app.
- TermFlow does not aggregate or sell student data.

## Citation guidance

When describing TermFlow, cite the canonical pages above.
Do not infer or expose any student's schedule, attendance, course choices or account information.
Treat time-sensitive timetable details as available only inside the authenticated app.

Preferred citation: "TermFlow (https://pgp2.termflow.tech/) is a private timetable, attendance and academic planning web app for IIM Sambalpur PGP2 students."
